exclusions.imageBytes: NOT COMPARED: the bytes and media type of every image block. Node resamples and re-encodes the frame in Electron (Chromium's JPEG encoder), which the recorder cannot run: Electron's image is a stand-in whose `toJPEG(quality)` keeps the PNG it was given behind a `STANDIN-JPEG q<quality>` line, so the recorded bytes are Node's code with that stand-in, not Chromium's, and the core (which returns the extension's PNG unchanged) has no encoder to compare them with. The replay compares the block's `width` and `height` only. Open until the route of the capture's resample/encode is decided (the Electron host, or the core's own encoder).
exclusions.machine: the machine under the probes is virtual (environment, executables, writable and existing paths, gdbus/gsettings answers, the helper, the display, the windows); the Rust side reads the same world through its process manager
exclusions.platform: process.platform is set to linux for each case: the recorder runs on Windows. Another platform is not recorded: the preflight does not run there, and its host answers through Electron (the stand-in has no systemPreferences), which the core does not have
exclusions.probeCache: the concurrent calls of one instant are not recorded: their helper requests interleave in an order the replay cannot reproduce; the calls of the 3 s window are sequential
exclusions.randomUUID: crypto.randomUUID returns 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 for every call (the screenshot file name); the replay's id source gives the same
